description: Metadata for Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence research, news, model, and program pages on baai.ac.cn and www.baai.ac.cn. baai.ac.cn does not resolve. www.baai.ac.cn returned one HTML shell for robots.txt and the research, news, system, and ecology paths. The shell does not name the publisher, a date or reuse licence, and news links leave the host, so the catalog is empty. Login walls, person profiles, PDFs, and off-host redirects are omitted. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. A missing publication date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
